cards.def: to stop sleeping
cards.ex: I usually wake up at six o'clock.
cards.exVn: Tôi thường thức dậy lúc sáu giờ.

cards.def: to get out of bed after sleeping
cards.ex: On weekdays, I get up at half past six.
cards.exVn: Vào các ngày trong tuần, tôi dậy lúc sáu giờ rưỡi.

cards.def: to put your clothes on
cards.ex: After breakfast, I get dressed and go to school.
cards.exVn: Sau bữa sáng, tôi mặc quần áo và đi học.

cards.def: to clean or make something tidy with a brush
cards.ex: I brush my teeth twice a day.
cards.exVn: Tôi đánh răng hai lần một ngày.

cards.def: to clean something or someone with water and usually soap
cards.ex: I wash my face as soon as I get up.
cards.exVn: Tôi rửa mặt ngay khi thức dậy.

cards.def: to rest with your eyes closed and your mind and body not active
cards.ex: I sleep for about seven hours every night.
cards.exVn: Tôi ngủ khoảng bảy tiếng mỗi đêm.

cards.def: the act of washing your body while standing under running water
cards.ex: I always have a quick shower in the morning.
cards.exVn: Tôi luôn tắm nhanh vào buổi sáng.

cards.def: to lie down in your bed in order to sleep
cards.ex: I usually go to bed at around eleven.
cards.exVn: Tôi thường đi ngủ vào khoảng mười một giờ.

cards.def: having a lot of things to do
cards.ex: I am very busy on Mondays because I have many classes.
cards.exVn: Tôi rất bận vào thứ Hai vì tôi có nhiều tiết học.

cards.def: in the way that happens most often
cards.ex: I usually walk to school with my friends.
cards.exVn: Tôi thường đi bộ đến trường cùng bạn bè.

cards.def: on some occasions but not always
cards.ex: I sometimes cook dinner for my family.
cards.exVn: Thỉnh thoảng tôi nấu bữa tối cho gia đình.

cards.def: time when you are not working or studying and can do what you like
cards.ex: In my free time, I like reading books.
cards.exVn: Vào thời gian rảnh, tôi thích đọc sách.

cards.vn: thói quen hằng ngày, nếp sinh hoạt
cards.def: the usual things you do and the order you do them in
cards.ex: My morning routine starts with a glass of water.
cards.exVn: Nếp sinh hoạt buổi sáng của tôi bắt đầu bằng một cốc nước.

cards.def: happening or done every day
cards.ex: Exercise is an important part of my daily life.
cards.exVn: Tập thể dục là một phần quan trọng trong cuộc sống hằng ngày của tôi.

cards.def: a clock that makes a noise at a time you choose to wake you up
cards.ex: My alarm clock goes off at six every morning.
cards.exVn: Đồng hồ báo thức của tôi reo lúc sáu giờ mỗi sáng.

cards.def: to prepare yourself for something, such as going out
cards.ex: It takes me twenty minutes to get ready for school.
cards.exVn: Tôi mất hai mươi phút để chuẩn bị đi học.

cards.def: to rest and become calm after work or worry
cards.ex: After work, I relax by listening to music.
cards.exVn: Sau giờ làm, tôi thư giãn bằng cách nghe nhạc.

cards.def: something that you do often and regularly, sometimes without thinking
cards.ex: Reading before bed is a good habit.
cards.exVn: Đọc sách trước khi ngủ là một thói quen tốt.

cards.def: to move or do something quickly because there is not much time
cards.ex: I had to hurry because I woke up late.
cards.exVn: Tôi phải vội vàng vì tôi dậy muộn.

cards.def: usually; in the way that happens most of the time
cards.ex: I normally have lunch at home with my parents.
cards.exVn: Thông thường tôi ăn trưa ở nhà với bố mẹ.

cards.def: time when you do not have to work or study
cards.ex: I don't have much spare time during the exam season.
cards.exVn: Tôi không có nhiều thời gian rảnh trong mùa thi.

cards.def: to make your hair tidy using a comb
cards.ex: She combs her hair before she leaves the house.
cards.exVn: Cô ấy chải tóc trước khi ra khỏi nhà.

cards.vn: làm khô, lau khô, sấy khô
cards.def: to remove water from something so that it is not wet
cards.ex: I dry my hair with a towel after my shower.
cards.exVn: Tôi lau khô tóc bằng khăn sau khi tắm.

cards.def: a plan that lists things you will do and when you will do them
cards.ex: My schedule is very full from Monday to Friday.
cards.exVn: Lịch trình của tôi rất kín từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu.

cards.def: to arrive at the place where you live
cards.ex: I usually get home at about five in the afternoon.
cards.exVn: Tôi thường về đến nhà vào khoảng năm giờ chiều.
